status: research-only retrospective source-event replay; no production behavior changed
mechanism: Use only attendance from each club previous home matches; compare market-only, crowd-only, Crown plus crowd. The target fixture attendance is excluded. Historical archive rows have dates but no first-publication or received timestamps.

fixed_method.training: expanding calendar-year; test year excluded; earlier years only
fixed_method.side_selection: argmax of predicted net AH return difference; every feature-complete test FID receives one experimental side; no EV threshold

receipt_audit.reason: The Transfermarkt source is a retrospective bulk snapshot with no contemporaneous row-level received/published timestamps. It stops before late-2026 actual receipt dates; no record is treated as a verified live-time feature.
